rows.en:
"Hey, {a}."
Motoki took my hand as I sat there spacing out, and suddenly squeezed it tight.
I turned bright red.
"...Hey, {a}.
Do you think Kanda's death was a suicide?
Or do you think someone killed him?
If someone did kill him, who do you think it was?"
Why was Motoki asking me something like that?{p}What was the point of asking that?
Suicide
His hysterical girlfriend killed him
The girl who secretly loved Kanda
The guy with a one-sided crush on that girl
Someone else

"I see.
So that's what you think, {a}.
...It doesn't really mean anything.
My grandma won't tell me who killed him either.
Maybe she really doesn't know.
But you know, the seventh one is coming soon.
Who do you think the seventh one is?
...That's right, it's Kanda. Kanda is coming here."{p}

Shindo looked a little uncomfortable.
"...Well, sure, it's not like I didn't know him.
He was in my class.
But I only knew him a little.
If it's Kanda you wanna know about, wouldn't Iwashita know more than me?
There was a rumor Iwashita was going out with Kanda."{p}

What?
My heart skipped, and I found myself turning to look at Iwashita.
Iwashita was smiling, her head bowed.
...Had I just said something terrible?
If Shindo was right, I'd just said that Iwashita killed Kanda.
And I'd even called her someone who might do anything...
I wondered if I had offended Iwashita.
"...Well, who knows?
Shindo, I don't think you should be so quick to believe rumors about people either.{p}

Did you see it?
Did you see something going on between Kanda and me?
You didn't see a thing, so for your own good, you'd better not spread strange rumors.
I can't stand liars, you know.
If I really had been going out with a man named Kanda, I'm sure I would have wanted to kill him.{p}

...More to the point, it was Fukuzawa, wasn't it?
I hear you secretly had feelings for Kanda.
And I heard that Kanda had recently started going out with a new girl.
Though, of course, that's nothing more than a rumor either.
I believe her name was Reiko Fukuzawa..."{p}

"What are you talking about?!"
Cutting Iwashita off, Fukuzawa slammed her hand down on the desk.
"Senior or not, there are things you just don't say!
Are you saying I killed Kanda?
Sure, I'll admit I liked him.
But why would I have to kill him?
When he died, I was the one who grieved the most!
I know the truth!
It was you!
You killed him!"{p}

I could only stare, stunned.
Fukuzawa was glaring at Iwashita with a terrifying look on her face.{p}
But Iwashita, meeting that glare, wasn't backing down either.{p}

"...Proof?
If you say I killed him, then go on, show me the proof.
Say one careless word, and I wouldn't mind killing you."
The two of them kept glaring at each other.
I had no idea what to do.{p}

It was Hosoda who stepped in between them.
"Now, now, please don't get so angry, you two.
Everyone, let's stop imagining weird things.
Whoever killed him, it has nothing to do with us here, does it?
What good is arguing about it going to do?
Let's all get along.
Okay?"
The two of them didn't pay the slightest attention to Hosoda.
They kept glaring at each other in silence.
Just then, Arai cleared his throat.{p}

"Ahem.
I don't know much about that story, but it sounds rather complicated.
...Hosoda, you like Fukuzawa, don't you?
That's only a guess, of course.
Ever since you got here, you've been sneaking glances at Fukuzawa, haven't you?
Is there something going on?"
Arai looked at Hosoda with probing eyes.{p}

"Ah ha ha ha, so you caught me, huh?
Truth is, I've been watching Fukuzawa this whole time, thinking a girl just my type had joined the first-years.
It's a one-sided crush, though...
I never dreamed I'd get to sit and talk with her like this today.
Oh, this is so embarrassing."
Hosoda bent his big body double, shaking with stifled laughter.{p}

Kazama got up from his seat.
"...How ridiculous.
Every one of you is connected to Kanda, one way or another.
This is a trap Hino set up, isn't it?
He was close with Kanda, after all.
I can't go along with this farce any longer.
I'm going home.
The rest of you can play detective all you like."
Just as Kazama's hand closed on the doorknob...{p}

"Wait!"
Motoki cried out.
"I told you the seventh one is coming, didn't I?
You can't go home before then."{p}

Hearing Motoki, Kazama let out an exaggerated sigh.
"Haaaaaah.
Look, what exactly am I to you?
We only met today, didn't we?
Your grandma living inside your body, hearing your grandpa's voice... You're in pretty bad shape, you know.
I'm a busy man.
I'm not like you common folk.
Sorry, but I'm going to do as I please."{p}

"No!
If you open the door now, you'll be killed.
Kanda is already here.
He's standing right on the other side of that door."
Motoki warned him sharply and pointed at the club room door.
At her words, Kazama turned to look at the door.
He furrowed his brow and strained his eyes, as if trying to see right through to the other side.{p}

...But that was absurd.
No matter what, there was no way a dead person would just come strolling into a place like this.{p}

"Hey, {a}.
Do you believe what I'm telling you?
Or do you think I'm a weird girl after all?"{p}Motoki suddenly asked me that.
I believe you
No matter what, I can't believe that
Let's rethink getting married after all. You're not normal

"...I believe you."
Now all I could do was believe what Motoki said.
The ominous air I'd felt ever since I entered this room wasn't just my imagination.
It had to be a sign that something was coming.
Motoki smiled at me, looking truly happy.{p}

At some point, Kazama had gone back to his seat too.
It seemed that even he didn't have the nerve to open the door.{p}

"He's there. I knew it.
Kanda is right outside the club room door.
Grandma told me so.
She says Kanda can't pass on unless he kills someone, anyone at all.
She says he has to take someone's head, the same way his was taken."
Motoki murmured quietly.
Everyone fell silent.{p}

Motoki went on.
"...The person who killed Kanda is one of us here.
What reason they had, why they had to kill him, I won't press for that.
But I think that person should be the one sacrificed. I don't know who it is, though."{p}

"You've gotta be kidding me!
I'm going home!"
Kazama stood up.
Then he ran over to the window.{p}

"...What the hell?!
The window won't open!
Fine, I'll smash this damn window!"
As Kazama grabbed a chair to hurl it at the window, Motoki spoke to him, perfectly calm.{p}

"...Nothing you do will work.
This room has been cursed by Kanda.
It's completely sealed.
There's no way out.
Until one of us dies, we can never leave this room."{p}

...Iwashita just glared at one spot on the door and answered without so much as a glance at Shindo.
"...Proof?
Do you have proof that I killed him?
Keep saying whatever you like with no proof, and I'll kill you."{p}

Fukuzawa didn't keep quiet either.
"You!
You're the one who killed my Kanda!
You said you liked me, so you were against Kanda and me going out.
That's why you hated him and killed him!
Take responsibility!"
The one Fukuzawa was hurling abuse at was Hosoda.{p}

Hosoda looked lost, on the verge of tears.
"...Fukuzawa, please don't say that.
You were never supposed to fall for a guy like Kanda.
You're my goddess.
I'm not saying I want to go out with you or anything like that, Fukuzawa.
Just looking at you is enough for me.
Just watching you from far away and imagining makes me happy, you know."
At last, Hosoda burst into tears.{p}
...What on earth was this? What was with these people?{p}

"...See? Kanda's angry.
What are you going to do?
If this keeps up, Kanda's going to come into the club room.

And then he'll kill every one of us."
By the time Motoki said that, it was already too late.{p}

The door was blown away by some supernatural force, and a man was standing there.
...It was probably Kanda.
I could only say 'probably' partly because I had never known Kanda, but more than that, because there was nothing above his neck.
A headless man in a school uniform stood there.{p}

"It wasn't me!
I'm sorry I made a move on Iwashita!
But I'm not the one who killed you, right?"
Kazama threw himself to the floor in an abject kowtow and begged for forgiveness.{p}

"I-I didn't do anything wrong.
What I did to you was just a little prank.
I never meant to bully you.
...Th-that was just a bit of fun!"
Shindo shrank back, ready to run, and apologized desperately in a trembling voice.{p}

"...K-Kanda.
It was just a little joke.
Iwashita kept flaunting what she had with you, so I just wanted to steal you away from her.
I wasn't planning to dump you or anything.
I'm sorry, I'm sorry... Please don't kill me!"
Fukuzawa's face was crumpled, her palms pressed together in prayer.{p}

"...Y-you know it wasn't me, right?
I-I have nothing to do with it.
Sure, I hated you for stealing Fukuzawa, so I pushed you down the stairs and put thumbtacks in your shoes, but nobody dies from stuff like that, right?
It wasn't me."
Hosoda was squeezing himself into a corner of the room, trying to get even a little farther away.{p}
...Arai said nothing, made no attempt to run, and just sat there without moving, his head bowed.{p}

"...You deserved to be killed.
Anyone at all could have done it.
I imagine everyone wanted to kill you, don't you think?
Do you hate me?
Do you think I killed you?
...Then why don't you kill me?"
Iwashita didn't try to run either. She stayed in her chair and glared at Kanda.{p}

...Even so, apart from Arai, the only one keeping silent, any one of them could have killed Kanda.
Even if Kanda's death had been a suicide, something one of them did could easily have been what drove him to it.{p}

Just then, a strange voice echoed inside my head.
I knew by instinct that it was Kanda's voice.
(...Who should I kill?
Who do I have to kill to be saved?
...One of the people here.
You decide.)
I looked around the club room.{p}

It seemed I was the only one who could hear that voice.
The voice pressed me to choose.
I had to make one of these people the victim.{p}What should I do?!
Akemi Iwashita
Nozomu Kazama
Makoto Shindo
Tomoharu Hosoda
Shoji Arai
Reiko Fukuzawa
Myself
Sanae Motoki

...Every one of them seemed like the killer.
...But there was no solid proof.
Besides, even if one of them was the killer, there was no way they'd admit to it.
But if this went on, we would all be killed.
...I couldn't possibly choose just one person.
In that instant, the name that came into my head was my own.
I steeled myself and took one step toward him.{p}

Just then,
Motoki, who had been holding my hand, began to shake violently.{p}

Suddenly, something like white smoke came out of her mouth.
In the smoke, the face of a woman with a horrifying expression appeared.
The instant it appeared, it lunged at Kanda.
The vengeful spirit's bitter groan thundered through the club room.{p}

...And then the thing was gone.
The headless man in the school uniform vanished like an illusion.{p}
Having seen that through, the demonic face floating in the smoke turned into a very calm, gentle face, and slid smoothly back into Motoki's mouth.{p}
...I felt as if I were dreaming.{p}

"Motoki!
...Sanae!"
I caught her as she crumpled.
Then I shook her by the shoulders.{p}

She let out a sleepy murmur and slowly opened her eyes.
"...Grandma says everything's okay now.
Isn't it great? Nobody died."
She was smiling.
I nodded hard.
It was all over.{p}

...After that, a week went by.
I never saw any of them again after that day.
In the end, I never found out who killed Kanda, or even whether it had been a suicide or a murder in the first place.
...Every human being has evil in their heart.
What holds it in check is self-control.{p}
